component.name: QDVC Spork
component.summary: Git client for bookmarked repositories and multiple remotes

description.p: QDVC Spork is a native GNOME Git client. Bookmark the repositories you care about, see their commits, changes and files side by side, and keep every remote in sync.

ul.li: Commit list with a branch graph, search, and an Uncommitted Changes row
Stage files or single hunks, commit and amend
Fetch, pull and push per remote, or push to all remotes at once
A dashboard showing which repositories need attention
Trust a local server's self-signed cert.pem without touching system settings
Open the repository you're in with spork .
